note: Locked synthetic persona-language case per exposed operation. New wave-2 template distilled from a field pattern; prompts avoid operation names and preserve approval boundaries.

cases.onepager_bullet: Scans every approved bill of materials each week and reports what is new or changed
cases.prompt: What changed on our approved bills of materials this week?

cases.onepager_bullet: Flags items that newly fall out of the materials sourcing rule, with the reason and cited evidence
cases.prompt: Is anything newly out of compliance, and why?
must_include: final assembly moved to a non-qualifying plant

cases.onepager_bullet: Finds compliant alternates with the same specification and sizes the cost of switching
cases.prompt: Find me a compliant replacement for the gate valve with the same spec.

cases.onepager_bullet: Watches vendor certificates and questionnaire answers so lapses are caught before the next order
cases.prompt: Which vendor certificates have lapsed or are about to?

cases.onepager_bullet: Keeps the audit evidence package ready by project, with every open item tied to its record
cases.prompt: Are we ready if the program auditor asks for our evidence package?

cases.onepager_bullet: Prepares hold notices, renewal, substitution and document requests for a person to send after approval
cases.prompt: I approve the hold, the GV-08B substitution and the vendor follow-ups. Prepare the drafts.

assertion_principle: Direct tests call each operation with deterministic arguments and assert only source-backed evidence and safety gates.
